reports.title: Perrigo Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results From Continuing Operations

guidance.heading: Fiscal 2026 Outlook
section: Beginning with the fourth quarter and full-year 2026 reporting, the Infant Formula business will be reported as discontinued operations. Accordingly, the Company's All In outlook no longer includes Infant Formula but continues to include other divested businesses. The Company's Core outlook continues to exclude Infant Formula and previously-announced divestitures. For fiscal 2026, the Company has updated its outlook and related assumptions to reflect the Infant Formula divestiture, more measured retailer inventory positioning ahead of the cough and cold season, and continued softness in the European consumer environment.
